name: ESP G100 Raptor (ESP Raptor, 100 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC w/o tip, printed ".130". Without the tip installed, determined at 50 yards (page footnote). No method mark: method not stated. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G1 BC w/tip, printed ".294 (O89)". With the tip installed, determined at 250 yards (page footnote). Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

note: Also printed: OAL w/o tip 1.110" (the length stored is with the tip). Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: w/o tip .454"; w/tip .754".
